title: Crochet Rose Anklet (Payal)
name: Rose Anklet
description: Free crochet rose anklet (payal) pattern: a chain band with little bumps, rolled roses and a bell. Easy, quick and printable. Free PDF download.
lead: A crochet payal: a light chain band with small bumps, two big rolled roses at the ends, a small one in the middle and a bell.
yarn: Thin cotton yarn in a band colour and a rose colour

materialsTable.details: Thin cotton yarn in a band colour and a rose colour
A small bell, needle and thread

rounds.text: sc, hdc, sc in the next ch and sl st.
ch 12 and repeat the bump. Keep repeating until the band fits around your ankle.
Magic ring, ch 6. In the 2nd ch from the hook: sc, hdc, dc in the next 2 ch, hdc, sl st into the ring. Make 3 petals in the ring.
Slip knot, ch 6. In the 2nd ch: sc, inc (2 sc in the same st), then 3 sc in each of the last 3 ch, sl st.
Insert the hook at the bottom, wrap 1 loop around the hook and pull the yarn through. Roll it up and fasten off.
Slip knot, ch 9. In the 2nd ch: sc, hdc, dc, dc inc, tr, tr inc, then 3 tr in each of the last 2 ch, sl st. Roll it up and fasten off.

finishing: Sew the bell to the band with a needle.
Attach the 2 big roses at both ends and the small one in the middle.
